operations.comment: ; Readability conventions: labels carry physical offsets to distinguish bank aliases.
; CPU execution views below are effective physical 8 KiB PRG slots, not MMC1 values.
; ObjectFlags: bit 0 selects pose-dependent bounds; bit 1 marks visibility;
; bit 2 bypasses camera compensation; bit 3 requests drawing; bit 5 supplies
; sprite priority, and bits 4/6 select rendering cadence/variant paths.
; Object fields are structure-of-arrays bases indexed by X or Y. Slot zero is the
; player, slots 1..4 are small spawned objects, slot 5 is the grapple, 6..18 general
; objects and slot 19 a special display object. Overlapping absolute operands may
; address a particular slot rather than a distinct variable. Unknown scratch
; addresses retain numeric spelling. Audio zero page is named separately because
; it belongs to a different banked interpreter contract.
; Vertical coordinates use 240-pixel pages; horizontal coordinates use 256 pixels.
; A classified fragment may end before its routine: the next opaque bytes remain
; unknown, even if the visible code falls through. Inline tables outside classified
; fragments are not silently promoted to data or code.
; 16-byte iNES header: mapper 1, 256 KiB PRG, CHR RAM and no trainer. Header bytes are preserved exactly.

; Room-pointer and coordinate/lookup resource prefix. The fixed room loader reads the room-pointer portion; separated records and repeated values support data throughout, but no single table count or whole-prefix schema is established.
